text_en: 1. Markets hit lows and recovered throughout the day, with the three major indices mixed. Agricultural stocks surged collectively, with nearly 20 stocks including Shennong Seed, Dunhuang Seed, and Nongfa Seed hitting limit-up. IT innovation concept rallied in the afternoon, with stocks like Cmest, Kylinsec, China Software, and Dongfang Zhongke hitting limit-up. Oil and gas concepts were active, with Sinopec Oilfield Equipment hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing power leasing concept corrected, with Chengdixiangjiang hitting limit-down; film and TV stocks fell, with Beijing Culture down over 9%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with over 3,200 stocks falling across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing exchanges, with turnover at 2.42 trillion yuan. By close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.19%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.56%, and the ChiNext fell 0.93%. 2. By sector concept, agriculture, oil and gas, pork, and Hainan led gains, while film and TV, gaming, batteries, and brain-computer interface led losses. 3.
